class.name: NetwInterestLayer
class.brief_description: A group of entities and the peers that can see them.
class.description:
The server adds [member entities] and [member viewers] to a layer, and [member policy] decides which peers see the entities. Two [NetwInterestLayer] objects with the same [member layer_id] are the same layer. Clients only learn what they can see. [codeblock] # server var sight := Netw.session(self).interest_layer(&"sight") sight.add_entity(target_entity) sight.add_viewer(observer_peer_id)
# client var sight := Netw.session(self).interest_layer(&"sight") sight.visibility_changed.connect(func(entity: NetwEntity, visible: bool): marker_of(entity.root).visible = visible ) [/codeblock] Changes apply at the end of the frame. On the server, use [signal interest_entered] and [signal interest_exited]. On a client, use [signal visibility_changed]. An entity inside a multiplayer scene is only visible to peers in that scene, whatever other layers say. A [NetwEntity] under another entity is only visible to peers that also see the entity above it, whatever its own layers say.

method.name: add_entity
method.description: Adds [param entity] to the layer. Returns [code]false[/code] when it was already in it. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: add_viewer
method.description: Adds [param peer_id] to [member viewers]. Returns [code]false[/code] when it already was. [param peer_id] must not be [code]0[/code].

method.name: has_entity
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param entity] is in the layer. Use [method is_visible_to] to ask who sees it.

method.name: has_viewer
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param peer_id] is in [member viewers]. With [constant LAYER_POLICY_HIDE_FROM_INSIDERS], viewers are the peers that cannot see.

method.name: is_visible_to
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when updates for [param entity] are sent to [param peer_id], considering every layer. It answers as [method NetwMultiplayer.interest_is_visible] does.

method.name: remove_entity
method.description: Removes [param entity] from the layer. Returns [code]false[/code] when it was not in it. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: remove_viewer
method.description: Removes [param peer_id] from [member viewers]. Returns [code]false[/code] when it was not a viewer.

method.name: set_policy
method.description: Sets [member policy]. Returns [code]false[/code] when it did not change.

method.name: stat
method.description: Returns the visibility counter [param stat] of this layer. [codeblock] var edges := layer.stat(NetwMultiplayer.LAYER_STAT_VISIBLE_EDGES) [/codeblock]

members.member: What happens to a peer's copy of an entity it stops seeing, unless the entity sets its own.
Whether a kept copy is still shown after the peer stops seeing it, unless the entity sets its own.

Called on the server once per frame with this layer. It returns every entity that belongs in the layer. [codeblock] sight.driver = func(layer: NetwInterestLayer) -> Array[NetwEntity]: return entities_near(beacon.position, 20.0) [/codeblock] If the result holds anything that is not an entity of this session, the layer does not change that frame.
The entities in the layer. On a client, only the ones it sees. Returns a copy, so use [method add_entity] and [method remove_entity] to change it.
Whether [member viewers] are the peers that see the entities, or the ones that do not.
The viewer peer ids. Returns a copy, so use [method add_viewer] and [method remove_viewer] to change it.

signal.name: entity_added
signal.description: Emitted when [param entity] is added to the layer.

signal.name: entity_removed
signal.description: Emitted when [param entity] is removed from the layer.

signal.name: interest_entered
signal.description: Emitted on the server when this layer shows [param entity] to [param peer_id], once [param peer_id] also sees the [NetwEntity] above it.

signal.name: interest_exited
signal.description: Emitted on the server when this layer stops showing [param entity] to [param peer_id], also when [param peer_id] stops seeing the [NetwEntity] above it or the layer is freed. A session that ends does not emit it.

signal.name: viewer_added
signal.description: Emitted when [param peer_id] is added to [member viewers].

signal.name: viewer_removed
signal.description: Emitted when [param peer_id] is removed from [member viewers].

signal.name: visibility_changed
signal.description: Emitted on a client when it starts or stops seeing [param entity] through this layer. A hidden entity is not despawned, see [signal NetwEntity.hidden].

constants.constant: Only viewers of the layer see its entities, as for a team or a private room.
Only peers that are not viewers see its entities.
Free the peer's copy. The entity becomes [constant NetwMultiplayer.ENTITY_STATE_ABSENT] there and can be shown again later.
Keep the peer's copy and stop updating it. Updates resume when it is visible again.
Call the custom callback given to [method NetwMultiplayer.interest_on_leave_policy].
Hide a copy kept by [constant LEAVE_POLICY_RETAIN].
Keep showing a copy kept by [constant LEAVE_POLICY_RETAIN] where it was last seen.
Call the custom callback given to [method NetwMultiplayer.interest_on_perception_policy].
